categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in construction engineering project management consulting services, with main business segments including engineering supervision (通信监理、土建监理、电力监理、水利监理), engineering consulting services (勘察与设计、咨询与代建、招标代理), and intelligent engineering management and software development. The company has obtained comprehensive engineering supervision qualifications from the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and can undertake engineering supervision, project management, and technical consulting services across all professional engineering categories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company applies advanced technologies including Internet of Things, 5G, BIM (Building Information Modeling), artificial intelligence, big data, and cloud computing to develop intelligent engineering management products. Core products include isDC (Intelligent Engineering Data Center), isPM (Intelligent Engineering Project Management Platform), isCM (Intelligent Engineering Full-Process Consulting Management Platform), isBM (Intelligent Engineering Enterprise Management Platform), and isGM (Intelligent Engineering Supervision Platform). The company has established standardized project management systems and processes across quality, safety, budget, training, assessment, and information technology dimensions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and private enterprises. Key customer types include telecommunications operators (particularly China Mobile), power companies, water conservancy authorities, and construction project owners. The company serves customers across communication infrastructure, power systems, water conservancy, building construction, municipal engineering, and other sectors. Major end markets include infrastructure construction, energy projects, and urban development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's business coverage spans all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in mainland China except Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. Major operating regions include South China (华南地区), East China (华东地区), Central China (华中地区), North China (华北地区), Southwest China (西南地区), Northeast China (东北地区), and Northwest China (西北地区). The company has established over 50 branch offices nationwide and operates through 19 subsidiary companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction engineering value chain. It provides project management consulting services during the planning, design, construction, and completion phases of engineering projects. The company acts as an independent third party between project owners (clients) and contractors, supervising and managing construction quality, progress, and costs. It also provides full-process consulting services spanning from feasibility studies through project operation and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Expanding comprehensive engineering supervision qualifications and obtaining high-level qualifications from transportation and other departments; (2) Advancing digital transformation through intelligent engineering management platforms and data-driven solutions; (3) Promoting full-process engineering consulting service model transformation; (4) Developing new energy and smart city solutions; (5) Implementing talent attraction and retention strategies; (6) Pursuing regional expansion and business localization. R&D focuses on intelligent construction management, BIM technology, digital twins, and cloud-based project management platforms.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through service fees for engineering supervision and project management consulting. Revenue recognition occurs as services are performed: (1) Communication and power supervision: recognized based on completed work quantities and contract unit prices; (2) Building and consulting services: recognized over the service period using straight-line method; (3) Bidding agency services: recognized upon issuance of winning notice; (4) Design services: recognized based on completion percentage of work stages. The company also generates revenue from software licensing and intelligent engineering management platform services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's engineering supervision industry with comprehensive qualifications. As of 2022, only 293 companies nationwide held comprehensive engineering supervision qualifications out of 16,270 qualified firms. The company ranks among top competitors and has been recognized as an AAA-level credit enterprise by the China Bidding and Tendering Association. It holds leadership positions in communication supervision, power supervision, and water conservancy supervision sectors. The company differentiates through standardized management systems, intelligent digital platforms, and extensive national service networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of 705.35 million yuan, representing 19.50% growth compared to 590.25 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 4.16 million yuan in 2023 (compared to -179.62 million yuan loss in 2022, primarily due to prior year goodwill impairment). Total assets reached 1.24 billion yuan at year-end 2023 (up 5.68% from 1.18 billion yuan in 2022). The company shows recovery trajectory with improving operational cash flow (33.22 million yuan in 2023 vs. 16.16 million yuan in 2022).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation includes: (1) Comprehensive engineering supervision qualifications enabling services across all professional categories; (2) Standardized management systems with ISO certifications and industry-leading standards; (3) Intelligent digital platforms (isDC, isPM, isCM, isBM, isGM) providing data-driven project management and risk prediction capabilities; (4) Extensive national service network with 50+ branch offices enabling rapid response; (5) Experienced professional team with 767 registered professionals and 2,469 specialized personnel; (6) Full-process consulting service model addressing entire project lifecycle; (7) Recognition as AAA-level credit enterprise with multiple industry awards and leadership positions in professional associations.
